chapter: New York: Bird and the loft years
title: Monk falling off the stage at the Village Gate
summary: She recalls seeing Monk dance and fall off the high stage at the Village Gate, then get back up and play.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution

blocks.x: On the East Side, all the way over on, uh… down where, where the Bluebird is… not Bluebird… Blue Note is. You kept going straight over… Art D‟Lugoff.
Oh, the Village… oh, the Village Gate.
Village Gate. And wasn‟t there an upstairs?
Okay. Brown, C.: But the [unintelligible] Rouge is now.
Yeah. Brown, C.: But the big stage is downstairs, yeah.
But, but I saw… Monk… I was there when Monk fell off. He was dancing around and fell off that stage.
He fell off. Brown, C.: Was he in pain?
